# SCI-RTC v0.1/r0.2 closing review

Date: `2026-08-18`

Verdict: the requested learn--resolve--apply scientific revision is complete
and ready for scientific-owner review. This is not scientific approval or a
claim about current implementation.

## Independence

The revision used the owner directive, approved Stage A author packet, and
existing r0.1 package authority only. No implementation, audit, test,
reduction, Unity, or production evidence was inspected.

## Structural and scientific checks

- 12 substantive science-team narrative sections and five diagrams.
- One six-file shared normative core imported exactly once by each view.
- 26 sequential definitions, 30 equation tags, 12 assumptions, 70 sequential
  requirements, and 38 sequential predictions.
- 18 retained author decisions and 36 owner entries: 31 open, one conditional,
  and four deferred.
- Exact `CROSSWALK.md` inventory plus dedicated r0.2 rationale crosswalk,
  change log, consistency report, and cross-package follow-up list.
- Engineering wrapper contains no independent displayed mathematics.

## Build and visual QA

Both sources compile with Tectonic 0.16.9 without warnings, missing glyphs,
overfull boxes, or unresolved references. The rationale is 33 pages and the
engineering view 24 pages. Both are letter-sized, unencrypted, and contain no
forms or JavaScript. Poppler rendered all 57 pages at 120 dpi; every rendered
page was inspected for clipping, overlap, broken tables/equations, unreadable
text, diagram defects, missing glyphs, and pagination faults. No defect
remains.

## Claim boundary

The package is a draft scientific contract for owner review. Implementation
conformity, representation fidelity, observational performance, validation,
science qualification, and production readiness remain unassessed.
